milestones.title: Preservation and practical workflow
milestones.basis: Recoverable sources/artifacts, operational instructions and checkpoints exist; final-profile handoff remains.

milestones.title: Requests, responses and recovery
milestones.basis: Actual request/retirement paths work and source-bound cancellation/epoch primitives exist; used error/recovery integration remains.

milestones.title: Execution and comparison runner
milestones.basis: Nine actual diagnostic/app behaviors accepted with raw results and retirement, including nonzero expected exit37; selected timeout/rejection/final-profile closure remains.

milestones.title: Memory and mapping correctness
milestones.basis: Actual malloc/mmap/data/mprotect roundtrip/munmap/free passed; forbidden-write enforcement, failure ownership and broader concurrent mapping evidence remain.

milestones.title: Useful C and Rust applications
milestones.basis: Useful dynamic-libc memory app accepted; file/signal/thread diagnostic evidence exists. Real Ruststd app compiles/references/stages but McKernel guest pending.

milestones.title: Native lifecycle and restoration
milestones.basis: Known native shutdown EBUSY remains. Running/log modules compiled but new runtime pending; cancellation/worker/epoch APIs remain unwired and restoration unproved.

milestones.title: Processes, threads and used syscalls
milestones.basis: TLS/mutex vectors and lifetime primitives exist; process creation/exec/wait, true contention and required final integration remain.

milestones.title: Used FPU/vector state
milestones.basis: Existing implementation is not zero; selected-profile preservation coverage is poorly measured and needs actual assessment.

milestones.title: Native modules and interfaces
milestones.basis: All three new Rust modules compiled/linked and matched artifacts independently accepted; updated-module load/runtime/lifecycle interfaces still need observation.

milestones.title: Rust and assembly integration
milestones.basis: Existing Rust consumers and compiled native/guest baseline preserved; changed final boundaries need matched artifact validation. Whole-image zero-C certification is outside practical scope.

milestones.title: Repeatable runnable build
milestones.basis: Pinned tools/dependencies and first module-only build path demonstrated, with honest artifact-only correction. One final clean recipe replay remains.

milestones.title: Integrated functional regression
milestones.basis: Nine behavior passes and relevant source/protocol negatives exist; final integrated regression and actual lifecycle defects remain.

milestones.title: Bounded repeatability and stress
milestones.basis: Repeated fresh diagnostic boots/launches provide partial evidence; final-profile ten native cycles,100launches and60-minute mixed run remain.

milestones.title: Practical delivery
milestones.basis: Runnable baseline instructions, provenance, artifacts and recoverable checkpoints exist; final functional set, capability summary and final review remain.

comparison_policy: Preserve this baseline; future same-scope comparisons may report estimated range-midpoint percentage-point deltas with actual code/test/integration evidence.
Do not infer numerical gains from activity/tokens/time/commits or merely removing qualification requirements.
Do not sum or average overlapping milestone percentages into an OS score.
Keep unchanged/negative estimates when warranted; uncertainty or unassessed coverage is not zero engineering progress.
Do not change practical check status or original formal acceptance from these estimates.
